Hi Rakkain, the journal I linked above contains the following link to an online version of average weighted currency indexes:
fxdata.net/

That tool is very limited in features but it is good enough to work with.

The most accurate indexes I've seen, with correct data across TFs (OHLC), are those programmed by Simon.

I think he shared enough info in his journal on how to make them (formulae).

I coded my own version for TradingView and they look like this, and you can also see the confluence I saw at the time for the trade on EURAUD:

دقیق‌ترین شاخص‌هایی که دیده‌ام، با دادهٔ درست در تایم‌فریم‌های مختلف (OHLC)، همان‌هایی هستند که Simon برنامه‌نویسی کرده است.

فکر می‌کنم او در ژورنالش اطلاعات کافی دربارهٔ ساختشان (فرمول‌ها) به اشتراک گذاشته است.
